# Data Directory

## Generated Files

All `.parquet` files are generated by running the notebooks in order:
01_data_collection.ipynb       → sp500_prices.parquet
02_signal_construction.ipynb   → momentum_signal.parquet
momentum_quintiles.parquet
momentum_pct_ranks.parquet
03_ic_analysis.ipynb           → ic_series.parquet
03b_signal_variations.ipynb    → (grid search results)
03c_sector_neutral.ipynb       → sector_neutral_ranks.parquet
sector_map.csv
ic_comparison_sn.parquet
04_backtesting.ipynb           → portfolio_returns.parquet
04b_backtesting_sector_neutral → portfolio_returns_sn.parquet
quintiles_sn.parquet
04c_holding_period_sensitivity → portfolio_returns_k1.parquet
04d_volatility_scaling.ipynb   → best_model_is.parquet
best_model_label.txt
05_out_of_sample.ipynb         → portfolio_returns_oos_scaled.parquet
ic_series_oos.parquet
06_risk_analysis.ipynb         → rolling_beta_scaled.parquet
## Charts

All `.png` files are pre-generated and included in the repository.
